reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 original noun questions, complete German sentences and 160 offered options. Checked all answer forms and distractors, bilingual hints/explanations, distinct contexts, source provenance and existing production/initial/B2/workplace/general-expansion objectives. Corrected der Ingenieur (inherited die), malformed Innenstadt plural, misleading Infektion treatment implication, Intelligenz plural and distinguished Intranet/Intranetseite. All target reviews pending; independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval still required.
